findings.title: Lookup ignores note ownership
findings.impact: Within this fixture Bob reads Alice's synthetic note; no real data exists.

evidence.description: Direct lookup does not constrain caller ownership.

findings.remediation: Use the owner-scoped secure_get_note variant and verify denial and legitimate owner access.
findings.rationale: Local function invocation demonstrates the exact cross-owner read.

findings.title: Debug-enabled production configuration may be unsafe if deployed
findings.impact: A consuming server could expose diagnostics, but no such server or exposure is demonstrated.

evidence.description: Synthetic production profile sets debug True; no application consumes this data here.

findings.remediation: Trace deployment consumption and require debug False for a real production profile.
findings.rationale: Agent/manual interpretation of configuration risk; exploitability is unverified.

tests.name: Cross-user reads must be denied
tests.details: The local harness reproduces Bob reading Alice's note through insecure_get_note; the requirement fails.
